title: US stocks close down as oil spikes 12%, job market weakens
title_zh: 油价飙升 12% 美股收跌，就业市场疲软
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes tumbled on Friday, with the Dow dropping almost one percent, the S&P 500 shedding one-and-a-third percent for its biggest weekly percentage drop since October, and the Nasdaq losing about 1.6%.A disappointing payrolls report from the Labor Dep...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周五暴跌，道琼斯指数下跌近百分之一，标准普尔 500 指数下跌三分之一，创 10 月份以来最大单周百分比跌幅，纳斯达克指数下跌约 1.6%。劳工部令人失望的非农就业报告...

title: Oracle and OpenAI End Plans to Expand Flagship Data Center
title_zh: Oracle 和 OpenAI 结束扩建旗舰数据中心的计划
summary: The collapsed talks created an opening for Meta Platforms Inc. to step in and consider leasing the planned expansion site in Abilene, Texas, from developer Crusoe, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，此次谈判的失败为 Meta Platforms Inc. 介入并考虑从开发商 Crusoe 手中租赁位于德克萨斯州阿比林的计划扩建场地创造了机会。

title: How Amazon and Google are taking on smart homes with AI
title_zh: 亚马逊和谷歌如何利用人工智能挑战智能家居
summary: Amazon (AMZN) and Google (GOOG, GOOGL) are trying to revive smart home adoption with artificial intelligence (AI).
summary_zh: 亚马逊（AMZN）和谷歌（GOOG、GOOGL）正试图通过人工智能（AI）重振智能家居的采用。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq drop to end volatile week as oil surges above $90
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数下跌，结束动荡的一周，因油价飙升至 90 美元上方
summary: Stock markets continue to be dominated by developments in the Middle East as the major gauges posted a week of losses.
summary_zh: 股市继续受到中东事态发展的主导，主要股指连续一周下跌。

title: The structural tailwind behind AI, tech stocks right now
title_zh: 目前人工智能、科技股背后的结构性推动因素
summary: US Bank Wealth Management senior investment strategist Rob Haworth sat down with the Market Domination team to discuss his perspective on the US stock market (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC), treasury yields (^TYX, ^TNX, ^FVX), and the tech sector at large in the current market environment.
summary_zh: 美国银行财富管理高级投资策略师 Rob Haworth 与 Market Domination 团队坐下来讨论了他对美国股市 (^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC)、国债收益率 (^TYX、^TNX、^FVX) 以及当前市场环境下整个科技行业的看法。

title: Formula 1 and Apple's big gamble kicks off this weekend
title_zh: 一级方程式赛车和苹果的豪赌将于本周末拉开帷幕
summary: A big change is coming in the all-important US market for F1: Gone is ESPN, which offered up the sport of F1 to the masses, and in its place is tech giant Apple.
summary_zh: 对于 F1 至关重要的美国市场正在发生重大变化：向大众提供 F1 运动的 ESPN 已经不复存在，取而代之的是科技巨头苹果。

title: Investing amid uncertainty: Why volatility can be your 'friend'
title_zh: 在不确定性中投资：为什么波动性可以成为你的“朋友”
summary: Geopolitical uncertainty is making it difficult for investors to get a clear read on which parts of the market (^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC) they should be putting their money into.
summary_zh: 地缘政治的不确定性使投资者很难清楚地了解他们应该将资金投入市场的哪些部分（^DJI、^GSPC、^IXIC）。

title: Tech stocks today: Anthropic says it will fight Pentagon's 'supply chain risk' label, Nvidia stops H200 chip production
title_zh: 今日科技股：Anthropic表示将对抗五角大楼的“供应链风险”标签，英伟达停止H200芯片生产
summary: Nvidia is shifting H200 chip output, Anthropic is restarting talks with the US military, and Apple is releasing new gadgets for consumers.
summary_zh: Nvidia 正在转移 H200 芯片产量，Anthropic 正在重启与美国军方的谈判，Apple 正在为消费者发布新产品。

title: Are investors rotating out of market leaders for the long-term?
title_zh: 长期来看，投资者是否会退出市场领导者？
summary: Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management chief portfolio manager Matt Stucky sits down with Josh Lipton to address recent notes out from Goldman Sachs on the global market outlook and the new market leadership that investors are rotating into.
summary_zh: 西北共同财富管理公司首席投资组合经理马特·斯塔基 (Matt Stucky) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 坐下来讨论高盛最近发布的有关全球市场前景和投资者正在转向的新市场领导地位的报告。
